# Sanitized Scrivener Windows 3.1.1 structural fixture

This fixture contains only invented generic titles and prose. Its binder and
supporting-file layout were shaped to exercise structures observed in a
locally supplied Scrivener for Windows 3.1.1.0 project. It is a regression
fixture, not an authentic Scrivener-created sample and not evidence of product
compatibility. Real-project compatibility is tested separately against the
author-provided project when it is present locally; that project is excluded
from Git.

The fixture exercises a Draft folder with one scene document, a Research
folder, a Trash folder with an excluded document, RTF paragraphs, Unicode,
bold/italic text, synopsis text, and binder metadata.
